description:
Your goal is to optimize the Jitsi Meet server configuration for low-power devices. You need to edit the web configuration file (located at ~/.jitsi-meet-cfg/web/config.js) to disable CPU-intensive features and enforce audio-only mode by default.

Specifically, you must set the following flags in the config object:
1. set 'disableAudioLevels' to true
2. set 'enableNoisyMicDetection' to false
3. set 'startAudioOnly' to true

You can use any text editor (vim, nano, etc.) to edit the file. Once done, save the file. You do not need to restart the containers, just saving the file is sufficient.
